name: browser-automation-studio.navigate-intent
purpose: Start one bounded AI vision-navigation against an existing browser session, read its status exactly once, and classify it as reached, human_pause, budget, in_progress, or failed.

session.description: Existing playwright-driver browser session id (from `browser-automation-studio observability sessions`).

max_steps.description: Step budget, 1..25 (the CLI allows up to 100; this program caps lower).

model.description: Vision model identifier. Required: the binding has no default and a caller must not hardcode a model slug (ai-gateway guardrail); pick from the navigator's documented models.

assumptions: browser-automation-studio is running and the session id names a live browser session
vision-navigation has no wait verb; a single status read right after start usually says navigating, and the caller re-reads by hand
the navigator's credit policy may refuse the start; that is reported refused, not retried
an unknown session id surfaces as `driver error: status 404` from the driver and is classified session_not_found
invariants: exactly one navigation is started; no retry, no abort, no resume
status is read exactly once; there is no polling loop
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.status: driver status at the single read: idle|navigating|awaiting_human|completed|failed|aborted|max_steps_reached|loop_detected
signals.outcome: reached | human_pause | budget | in_progress | failed | unknown
